source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of atomic spectra (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Jab atoms kisi khaas wavelength ki roshni chhorte (emit karte) ya jazb (absorb) karte hain to atomic spectra nazar aate hain; inhein bil-tarteeb emission spectra aur absorption spectra kehte hain. Atomic spectra is baat ka saboot hain ke atom ke electrons sirf khaas, alag alag (discrete) energy levels ke darmiyan hi ja sakte hain. Jab atom ke electrons energy jazb karte hain to woh neeche ke energy levels se oopar ke levels par chale jate hain. Yeh excited (oopar gaye hue) electrons wapas ground state mein aate hue energy chhorte hain aur emission spectra banate hain.

blocks.alt: Oopar: kaali patti par 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par chaar rangeen lakeerein, mehwar Wavelength, lambda (nm). Neeche: tawanai ki satahein n = 2, 3, 4 aur 5, aur n = 3 (gulabi), n = 4 (halka neela) aur n = 5 (gehra neela) se n = 2 tak teen mote neeche jaate teer; har aik se usi rang ka lehar-numa photon baen taraf nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.2: Hydrogen ka emission spectrum (kitab ki Figure 29.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer aik electron ka oopar ki satah se n = 2 par girna hai, aur har girne par aik photon (lehar-numa teer) nikalta hai. Jitna bara farq (gap), utni zyada tawanai aur utni chhoti wavelength: n = 3 se n = 2 surkh 656 nm lakeer deta hai, n = 4 se n = 2 neeli-hari 486 nm, aur n = 5 se n = 2 neeli 434 nm. Patti mein chauthi lakeer 410 nm n = 6 se n = 2 se aati hai; kitab ka khaaka sirf teen teer dikhata hai.
Emission spectra kam pressure wali gas ko garam kar ke banaye ja sakte hain. Garmi electrons ko oopar ke energy levels tak le jane ke liye energy deti hai.

Jab electron wapas neeche ke energy level par aata hai to woh aik photon chhorta hai. Har aisi chhalang (transition) roshni ki aik khaas wavelength deti hai jo spectrum mein aik lakeer (spectral line) ki shakal mein dikhti hai. Is tarah emission spectrum mein kuch alag alag wavelengths hoti hain jo kaale background par rangeen lakeeron ki shakal mein nazar aati hain.

Doosri taraf, absorption spectrum mein ground state ke electrons energy jazb kar ke oopar ke levels par jate hain, aur guzarne wali roshni mein kaali lakeerein (dark bands) reh jati hain. Absorption spectra safaid (white) roshni ko thandi, kam pressure wali gas se guzar kar banaye ja sakte hain. Sirf woh photons jazb hote hain jin ki energy electrons ko excite karne ke liye bilkul barabar ho. Har jazb hua photon aik khaas wavelength ka hota hai jo rangeen background par kaali lakeer ki shakal mein dikhta hai. Yeh lakeerein usi element ke emission spectrum ki lakeeron wali jagah par hi hoti hain. Absorption spectrum goya emission spectrum ka photographic negative hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: banafshi se surkh tak musalsal rangeen patti jis par 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par kaali lakeerein hain, mehwar Wavelength, lambda (nm). Neeche: satahein n = 2, 3, 4 aur 5, aur n = 2 se n = 3 (gulabi), n = 4 (halka neela) aur n = 5 (gehra neela) tak teen mote oopar jaate teer; har teer tak usi rang ka lehar-numa photon baen taraf se aata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.3: Hydrogen ka absorption spectrum (kitab ki Figure 29.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Absorption mein ulta hota hai: safaid roshni ke wohi photons jazb hote hain jin ki tawanai kisi gap ke barabar ho, aur electron n = 2 se oopar chala jata hai. Isi liye rangeen patti mein bilkul unhi wavelengths (410, 434, 486, 656 nm) par kaali lakeerein hain jahan emission mein chamakdar lakeerein thin.

blocks.prompt: Kisi element ke absorption spectrum ki kaali lakeerein us ke emission spectrum ki chamakdar lakeeron wali wavelengths par hi kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono unhi energy levels ke darmiyan chhalangon (transitions) se bante hain. Absorption mein electron farq jitni energy le kar oopar jata hai aur emission mein utni hi energy chhor kar neeche aata hai, is liye photon ki energy aur wavelength dono mein aik jaisi hoti hai.

items: Emission: kaale background par rangeen lakeerein (electrons neeche girte hain).
Absorption: rangeen spectrum par kaali lakeerein (electrons oopar jate hain).
